name: 顧客一覧の保存済み表示タブ帯
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied HubSpot saved-view tab strip as a faithful Japanese localization. The crop is an extremely wide, shallow strip exactly 1708x51 pixels (33.49:1). Keep all tabs and actions in a single compact horizontal line with the same divider positions, tab widths, and very low row height. No surrounding page, search toolbar, browser chrome, or extra content.

From left to right show five saved-view tabs, each in one line: 「すべての連絡先」 with a small close × at the far right of that first tab; 「ニュースレター購読者」; 「配信停止」; 「すべての顧客」; 「米国の顧客」. Use a white first tab and very pale cool-gray neighboring tabs with fine light-gray borders and vertical dividers. Keep compact dark blue-gray sans-serif text, vertically centered.

After the fifth tab, align a small teal plus icon and the teal action 「ビューを追加 (5/5)」. At the far right, show the teal action 「すべてのビュー」. Preserve the source spacing and compact baseline alignment. No rounded pills, cards, wrapping, extra icons, or added tabs. The full composition must remain 1708x51 (33.49:1) without blank bands; use the crop as the authority for tab boundaries, wording order, and state.
reviewNotes: v001 contains all five localized saved-view tabs, the first-tab close icon, Add view and All Views actions. However, ImageGen returned 2171x724 (3.00:1) with large blank bands and slight right-edge clipping instead of the source 1708x51 (33.49:1). Prior extra-wide items repeatedly hit 3:1 and reframing did not fix them, so recorded needs-correction after one evidence-based attempt.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
